verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows built-in AI drafting or refining subject lines or email copy inside the email composer. The AI evidence covers live-chat summaries and replies, data Q&A via Aura AI, and campaign management from external AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude. Subject-line A/B testing and the drag-and-drop editor are adjacent features, not AI copy generation.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can have the platform's built-in AI draft or refine subject lines and email copy from a brief, inside the composer
